units.source_text: 浮舟犹如做了一个噩梦，汗流浃背地躺着。

en.t: Ukifune lay there drenched in sweat, as though she had just awakened from a nightmare.

units.source_text: 乳母替她打扇，说道：“住在这种地方，万事都要当心，实在很不方便！

en.t: Her nurse fanned her and said, "Living in a place like this, one has to be careful about everything; it is truly inconvenient!

units.source_text: 今天已被他发现，来过一次，以后决不会有好事。

en.t: Now that he has found you today and has come here once, nothing good can come of it later.

units.source_text: 啊呀，真可怕啊！

en.t: Oh, how dreadful!

units.source_text: 尽管他是身份高贵的皇子，但名分上是姐夫，毕竟不成体统。

en.t: Even though he is a prince of high rank, in name he is your brother-in-law, and in the end it is simply improper.

units.source_text: 不拘好坏，总得另选一个没有瓜葛的人才是。

en.t: Whether for better or worse, you must choose someone else who has no such connection.

units.source_text: 今天倘真的被他骗上，小姐名誉攸关，所以我装出降伏恶魔的神态，眼睛一直盯住他。

en.t: If he had truly deceived you today, my lady's honor would have been at stake, so I put on the look of someone subduing a demon and kept my eyes fixed on him.

units.source_text: 他把我看作一个最讨厌的女仆，狠狠地拧我的手。

en.t: He treated me as the most hateful maidservant and cruelly twisted my hand.

units.source_text: 这是下等人求爱的态度，实在可笑之极。

en.t: That is the way a lowborn man courts a woman, and it is utterly ridiculous.

units.source_text: 今天我们家里，常陆守和夫人闹得很厉害呢！

en.t: Today at our house, the Governor of Hitachi and his wife had a terrible quarrel!

units.source_text: 常陆守说：‘你只照顾那一个，把我的女儿完全抛弃了。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi said, 'You care only for that one girl and have completely abandoned my daughter.

units.source_text: 新女婿上门的日子，你故意出宿他处，成什么样子！’

en.t: On the very day the new son-in-law came to visit, you deliberately went out and stayed elsewhere. What kind of behavior is that!'

units.source_text: 常陆守说得声势汹汹，连仆从们都听不惯，替夫人抱屈呢。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi spoke so fiercely that even the servants could hardly bear to hear it and felt sorry for his wife.

units.source_text: 都是那个左近少将不好，此人实在可恶。

en.t: It is all that Lieutenant of the Left Guard's fault; the man is truly hateful.

units.source_text: 如果没有他这件事情，家里虽然常常小有争执，却并无大碍，多年来一直平安到如今了。”

en.t: If not for this affair of his, although there were often small disputes in the household, nothing serious ever happened, and for many years things had remained peaceful until now."

units.source_text: 说着连声叹息。

en.t: As she spoke, she sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 浮舟此时无暇考虑他事，只是悲伤这从未遭逢过的奇耻大辱，还要担心二女公子对此事如何想法。

en.t: At that moment Ukifune had no room to think of anything else; she only grieved over this unprecedented humiliation and worried about what the Second Princess would think of it.

units.source_text: 痛苦之极，只管俯伏着嘤嘤啜泣。

en.t: In the extremity of her anguish, she simply lay face down and sobbed softly.

units.source_text: 乳母很可怜她，安慰她道：“小姐何必如此伤心！

en.t: Her nurse pitied her deeply and comforted her, saying, "My lady, why be so heartbroken?

units.source_text: 没有母亲的人，孤苦无依，这才可悲呢。

en.t: Those without a mother, lonely and with no one to depend on, are the ones who are truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 没有父亲而被世人看轻，原是遗憾之事，但倘有父亲而被不慈的继母所憎恶，还是没有父亲的好得多。

en.t: It is certainly regrettable to have no father and be looked down on by the world, but if one has a father only to be hated by an unkind stepmother, it is far better to have no father at all.

units.source_text: 总之，母亲定会替你安排，你切不可灰心。

en.t: In any case, your mother will surely make arrangements for you, so you must not lose heart.

units.source_text: 何况还有初濑的观世音菩萨呵护你，可怜你的身世而保佑你。

en.t: Besides, the Kannon of Hatsuse is watching over you, taking pity on your circumstances and protecting you.

units.source_text: 像你这样不惯旅行的人，几次不惮跋涉而前往进香，菩萨定会答应你的祈愿而赐你幸福，使得向来侮蔑你的人又惊又愧。

en.t: For someone like you, unused to travel, to make the difficult pilgrimage several times, the bodhisattva will surely answer your prayers and grant you happiness, leaving those who have always scorned you both astonished and ashamed.

units.source_text: 我们的小姐哪里会受世人耻笑呢！”

en.t: How could our young lady ever become the laughingstock of the world!"

units.source_text: 她说得很乐观。

en.t: She spoke with great optimism.
